title: A2v10 metadata.json (enum)
description: One enum set: a closed list of codes that a column points at and that code branches on. An open list somebody browses is a catalog, not this. The baseline is the platform's (Id, Name, Memo, Order, Void); 'fields' adds the author's own columns, which every value fills by name and which travel with every reference to the set. No forms, no rules: nothing renders a page here, the values arrive with whatever screen references them.

description.description: For the model, not the platform: nothing reads it - no generator, runtime or deploy. Where the model writes down what it must know about this endpoint - its rules and the reasons for them - so the next session finds them here.

table.description: The SQL table of the set, in schema 'enm'. Declared and never derived from the folder - the same rule every other endpoint follows.

model.description: Base of the generated names: the row type ('T' + model), the array (its plural) and the localization keys of the values. Defaults to the endpoint folder name in PascalCase, so a folder written in kebab-case ('vat-rate') gives 'VatRate'.

fields.description: The author's own columns of a value, next to the baseline: "Rate": { "type": "percent" }. Each value fills them under the column's name; they ride with every reference to the set, so a record reads row.VatRate.Rate. A column of type 'color' makes the values draw as badges.

values.description: The values of the set, in the order they are shown - 'order' is the position here and is never written. The list is the whole truth about the set: a value dropped from it is marked void on deploy, never deleted, so the records that carry it keep it and it merely stops being offered. The 'All' row a filter shows is not declared here - the platform adds it, with the empty string for a key.

items.description: Any key besides the ones below is a column of 'fields', spelled as the column, with a scalar value: { "id": "20", "Rate": 0.2 }. A column the value does not name is left as the deploy found it. A key that is no column fails the load.

id.description: The code, as the referencing column stores it.

name.description: Presentation. Defaults to the localization key '@[{model}.{id}]'. The key carries the set's name on purpose: two equal codes in two sets would otherwise collapse into one translation, and that does not surface until the second language.

color.description: Fills the column 'Color', which an enum has when 'fields' declares it with type 'color'; without that column it fails the load. Lower case: the value goes straight into a CSS class, where case matters.

void.description: Withdrawn from use: stays in the records that already carry it and leaves the list of candidates. A record holding a void value opens with an empty control and cannot be saved until a live value is picked - which is the intended migration, not a defect.
